Uber commenced Europe’s first fully driverless robotaxi service in Croatia, operating without human safety drivers and signaling a major acceleration in autonomous vehicle commercialization [Uber launched driverless service](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQQ09uc1FWTGJmNVBER3NyVENJMHVfYWJYcENNdjhsc3dRSkxDejFYdmdOSUFvM1dMNHlCNzVTc0sxZWJzdEdmWmZ1NXZzRmx5aElBR09JZ3U5OURvVFdpVGc1SURETkl1MmwzQ0dmeXV5OUkyQXBZMC03Rl9oYU9kWnN6RHpDOFJFTzVXdW5QbEVSanlMTzBnWnlHaVJFXzhsN1BUbHkteGdJeXJzeU5zNWlLSlVoMkc4NTJLdg?oc=5). Tesla simultaneously launched its first Cybercab robotaxis in Texas and prepared static displays for Beijing and Shanghai, expanding its global autonomous strategy [Tesla launched Cybercabs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNVTdTeWNxeE9xLWkwZGxqQmlCVUQ2T1hOQ2x2WFFtaFNhWmhnWVJZbTQ1MEotWWZXTUh0V3lnX3IwQU5pSERvbnhmRGo3cFJWenFXVU5YT0hrQkR4U1FQN2t6R1FtLVZDY0ZtdERROGlwMWJGTWtZd2prZnRpTmJDalBjdERKWnBjUUs2WnYzUQ?oc=5). These developments coincide with Texas Department of Transportation confirmation that air taxis are taking flight this fall under a new federal program, while Joby Aviation completed its first New York City eVTOL flights from JFK to Manhattan [Texas air taxis launched](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Geopolitical conflicts severely disrupted transportation infrastructure, as Russian drone strikes hit a train near the Polish border and caused international outcry [Russian drones struck train](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5). Houthi claims of strikes on Saudi Arabia triggered oil price surges past $107 and threatened global supply chains, while drones from Iraq knocked out a Saudi oil pipeline [Drones hit Saudi pipeline](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/other/drones-from-iraq-knock-out-saudi-oil-pipeline-as-trump-points-to-iran/ar-AA2c6bR4?ocid=BingNewsVerp). In response to these threats, the European Union released $7 billion for Ukraine to purchase Patriot missiles and drones, enabling orders for American interceptors [EU released funds for Ukraine](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/09/12/the-eu-just-released-7-billion-for-ukraine-to-buy-patriot-missiles-and-drones/).

Defense technology sectors saw significant capital and operational shifts as Sweden’s Freya Industries raised $620K to scale drone detection across Europe [Freya Industries raised capital](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBB
